title: [Riso] Compensation Ratio – CSV import – Explicit 100% row – 100% persists
description: AC 01.2 — Equivalence Partitioning / CRUD — An explicit allowed value imports unchanged.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce organization.\n- A lesson CSV template includes the Compensation Ratio column.\n- A CSV row has valid required lesson data.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff sets Compensation Ratio to 100% in the CSV row."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff imports the CSV and opens the imported lesson."
steps_result: 1. "The CSV row contains the explicit allowed value."\n2. "The imported lesson has Compensation Ratio 100%."

title: [Riso] Compensation Ratio – CSV import – NA row value – Invalid row rejected
description: AC 01.2 — Negative / Equivalence Partitioning — A value not defined by the PRD is rejected.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce organization.\n- A lesson CSV template includes the Compensation Ratio column.\n- A CSV row has valid required lesson data except Compensation Ratio.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff sets Compensation Ratio to NA in the CSV row."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff imports the CSV."
steps_result: 1. "The CSV row contains an invalid Compensation Ratio."\n2. "The row is rejected and displays a row-level error identifying Compensation Ratio."

title: [Riso] Compensation Ratio – CSV import – Mixed valid and invalid rows – Valid rows continue
description: AC 01.2 — Decision Table / Regression — One invalid row does not prevent valid and blank rows from importing.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce organization.\n- A lesson CSV template includes the Compensation Ratio column.\n- A four-row CSV has distinct valid lesson names.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff prepares four CSV rows with Compensation Ratio values 100%, 60%, blank, and NA."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff imports the CSV."\n3. "HQ or CM Staff opens the three imported lessons."
steps_result: 1. "The file contains three importable rows and one invalid row."\n2. "Rows 1 through 3 import and row 4 is rejected with a row-level Compensation Ratio error."\n3. "Their Compensation Ratios are 100%, 60%, and 100% respectively."
steps_data: 1. "row 1 = 100%; row 2 = 60%; row 3 = blank; row 4 = NA"\n2. "expected imported rows = 1, 2, 3; rejected row = 4"\n3. "expected ratios = 100%, 60%, 100%"

title: [Riso] Compensation Ratio – CSV import – Corrected rejected row – Retry imports corrected value
description: AC 01.2 — Negative / Regression — A rejected row can be corrected and retried with an allowed value.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce organization.\n- A CSV row with Compensation Ratio NA was rejected with a row-level error.\n- The CSV import flow provides the documented correction and retry path.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff corrects the rejected row's Compensation Ratio to 60%."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff retries the corrected row through the CSV import flow."\n3. "HQ or CM Staff opens the imported lesson."
steps_result: 1. "The corrected row contains an allowed value."\n2. "The corrected row imports without a Compensation Ratio error."\n3. "The lesson has Compensation Ratio 60%."
